items.q: How many days passed between my visit to the Museum of Modern Art (MoMA) and the 'Ancient Civilizations' exhibit at the Metropolitan Museum of Art?
items.gold: 7 days. 8 days (including the last day) is also acceptable.
items.pred: I’m sorry, but I don’t have any record of when you visited MoMA, so I can’t calculate the number of days between that visit and the “Ancient Civilizations” exhibit at the Met. If you can tell me the MoMA visit date, I’ll be happy to do the math for you.
